strings.alarm_empty_hint: Dala i-alamu yakho yokuqala ukuze uqale ukuhlela umsebenzi wakho wamashifu

strings.alarm_exact_permission_message: Ukuze ulondoloze futhi uvule ama-alamu okuvuka anembile, vumela lolu hlelo lokusebenza ukuthi luhlele ama-alamu ezilungiselelweni zesistimu.
strings.alarm_readiness_description: Kwamanye amadivayisi, ikakhulukazi i-Xiaomi/MIUI, ama-alamu angase abambezeleke noma angakhali lapho uhlelo lokusebenza luvaliwe. Hlola izinto ezingezansi ukuze uthuthukise ukwethembeka.
strings.alarm_xiaomi_tip_message: Uma ama-alamu esasebenza ngokungazinzi lapho uhlelo lokusebenza luvaliwe, vumela ukuziqalela kwe-ShiftAlarm futhi ususe imikhawulo yebhethri ezilungiselelweni ze-MIUI.
strings.alarm_notifications_not_ready: Izaziso zivaliwe. Izaziso ze-alamu zingase zifihlwe noma zivinjwe.
strings.alarm_exact_not_ready: Ama-alamu anembile awavunyelwe. Ama-alamu okuvuka angase angakhali ngesikhathi.
strings.alarm_battery_ready: Imikhawulo yebhethri yalolu hlelo lokusebenza incishisiwe.
strings.alarm_battery_not_ready: Ukulungiselelwa kwebhethri kusasebenza. I-Xiaomi/MIUI ingase ibambezele noma ivimbe ama-alamu lapho uhlelo lokusebenza luvaliwe.
strings.alarm_app_settings_description: Vula ikhasi lezilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza ukuze uhlole ukuziqalela, umsebenzi wangemuva, ukuziphatha kwesikrini sokukhiya nezimvume eziqondene nomkhiqizi.
strings.alarm_runtime_log_description: Vula ilogi ephelele yemicimbi, bese uyikopisha futhi uyithumele ukuze ihlaziywe.
strings.alarm_module_rebuild_placeholder: Imojuli ye-alamu isethwe kabusha futhi isilungele ukwakhiwa kabusha okuhlanzekile.
strings.alarm_runtime_log_placeholder_descriptio: Imojuli ye-alamu yangaphambilini isusiwe. Ukuxilonga kuzobuya ngemva kokwakhiwa kabusha.
strings.alarm_diagnostics_unavailable_body: Imojuli ye-alamu isusiwe. Ukuxilonga kuzobuya ngemva kokwakhiwa kabusha.
strings.alarm_reliability_warning_body: Ezinye izilungiselelo ezidingekayo azivuliwe. Kwamanye amadivayisi, ama-alamu angase angakhali lapho uhlelo lokusebenza luvaliwe noma lususiwe ezinhlelweni zakamuva.
strings.alarm_custom_sound_limit_body: Ungalondoloza imisindo eyenziwe ngokwezifiso efinyelela ku-{count}.
strings.alarm_sound_custom_limit_reached: Ungalondoloza imisindo eyenziwe ngokwezifiso efinyelela ku-{count}
strings.alarm_sound_delete_confirm_body: Lo msindo uzosuswa ohlwini. Ama-alamu awusebenzisayo azoshintshela kumsindo wesistimu.
strings.alarm_sound_limit_body: Ungalondoloza imisindo eyenziwe ngokwezifiso efinyelela ku-{count}.
strings.alarm_sound_duplicate_name_body: Umsindo owenziwe ngokwezifiso onegama lefayela elifanayo usulondoloziwe.
strings.alarm_invalid_date_time_past: Usuku nesikhathi okukhethiwe kufanele kube ngemva kwesikhathi samanje.
strings.alarm_gate_body: Ukuze ama-alamu asebenze ngokuthembekile, sicela uvumele izilungiselelo nezimvume ezidingekayo.
strings.alarm_gate_warning: Ngaphandle kwalezi zilungiselelo ama-alamu angase ANGASEBENZI lapho uhlelo lokusebenza luvaliwe.
strings.alarm_gate_battery_hint: Ukulungisa ibhethri kuqala kuvula izilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza. Kwamanye amadivayisi, bese uvumela ukusetshenziswa kwangemuva noma ususe imikhawulo yebhethri yalolu hlelo lokusebenza.
strings.alarm_reliability_all_ready: Konke kusethiwe. Ama-alamu kufanele asebenze ngokuthembekile.
strings.alarm_reliability_not_ready: Ezinye izilungiselelo zingavimbela ama-alamu ukuthi asebenze lapho uhlelo lokusebenza luvaliwe.
strings.alarm_reliability_important_hint: Okubalulekile: ukulungisa ibhethri kuqala kuvula izilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza. Kwamanye amadivayisi, bese uvumela ukusetshenziswa kwangemuva noma ususe imikhawulo yebhethri yalolu hlelo lokusebenza.
strings.alarm_vendor_hint_body: Ku-Xiaomi, Samsung nakwamanye amadivayisi, imikhawulo eyengeziwe yebhethri ingavimba ama-alamu lapho uhlelo lokusebenza luvaliwe. Uma kudingeka, vula izilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza bese uvumela umsebenzi wangemuva walolu hlelo lokusebenza.
strings.alarm_runtime_log_body: Vula isikrini sokuxilonga ukuze uhlole imicimbi ye-alamu nokusebenza kokwethembeka.
strings.settings_permissions_section_ready: Zonke izimvume zama-alamu nezilungiselelo zokwethembeka ezidingekayo zisethiwe.
strings.settings_permissions_section_not_ready: Hlola izimvume nezilungiselelo zebhethri ukuze ama-alamu asebenze ngokuthembekile.
strings.settings_diagnostics_section_body: Hlola imicimbi yokusebenza kwe-alamu nokuxilongwa kokwethembeka.
strings.settings_theme_section_body: Khetha indlela yokubukeka nokuziphatha kwempendulo yokuthinta.
strings.settings_haptic_body: Vumela impendulo emfushane yokudlidliza ekusebenzisaneni okusekelwayo ohlelweni lokusebenza.
strings.settings_language_sheet_body: Uhlelo lokusebenza lusebenzisa ngokuzenzakalelayo ulimi lwesistimu uma lutholakala. Lapha ungalanda mathupha futhi ushintshele kolunye ulimi olusekelwayo.
strings.settings_language_load_failed: Uhlu lwezilimi alukwazanga ukulayishwa. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.
strings.settings_language_download_failed: Ulimi olukhethiwe alukwazanga ukulandwa noma ukufakwa.
strings.settings_contact_button_body: Vula uhlelo lwakho lwe-imeyili bese udala umlayezo oya ku-support@insdeco.ru.
strings.settings_contact_email_unavailable: Alukho uhlelo lwe-imeyili olutholakalayo kule divayisi.
strings.settings_diagnostics_button_body: Vula izingxenye zokuxilonga zemisebenzi ehlukene yohlelo lokusebenza.
strings.settings_language_button_body_short: Vula izilimi zohlelo lokusebenza ezitholakalayo futhi uphathe ukufakwa mathupha.
strings.settings_permissions_header_body: Izimvume zama-alamu nama-alamu endawo, ukufinyelela indawo nezilungiselelo zokwethembeka eziqondene nedivayisi ziqoqwe lapha.
strings.settings_diagnostics_header_body: Izingxenye zokuxilonga zemisebenzi ehlukene yohlelo lokusebenza ziqoqwe lapha.
strings.settings_theme_header_body: Khetha indlela yokubukeka nokuziphatha kokudlidliza kwesixhumi esibonakalayo.
strings.settings_diagnostics_master_body: Iswishi enkulu yazo zonke izingxenye zokuxilonga ohlelweni lokusebenza.
strings.settings_diagnostics_alarm_body: Imicimbi yokulethwa kwe-alamu, ukuhlela, ukubuyisela, ukuvikela nokukhala.
strings.settings_diagnostics_timer_body: Imicimbi yokuqalisa, ukumisa kancane, ukuqhubeka, ukusetha kabusha, ukuphela, ukubuyisela, izaziso nesikrini sokuphela kwesibali sikhathi.
strings.alarm_diagnostics_actions_body: Kopisha, sula noma uthumele umbiko wamanje wokuxilonga ama-alamu.
strings.alarm_diagnostics_send_hint: Ukuze uthumele umbiko wokuxilonga, kunconywa ukukhetha uhlelo lwe-imeyili.
strings.alarm_diagnostics_clear_confirm_body: Yonke imicimbi yokuxilonga elondoloziwe izosuswa unomphela.
strings.settings_diagnostics_clock_body: Uhlu lwamawashi omhlaba, inqubo yokubuyisela nezenzo zokwengeza noma ukususa izindawo zesikhathi.
strings.clock_diagnostics_send_hint: Ukuze uthumele umbiko wokuxilonga, kunconywa ukukhetha uhlelo lwe-imeyili.
strings.clock_runtime_log_empty_body: Sebenzisa futhi imisebenzi yamawashi omhlaba, ilogi yemicimbi izovela lapha.
strings.clock_diagnostics_clear_confirm_body: Yonke imicimbi yokuxilonga iwashi elondoloziwe izosuswa unomphela.
strings.timer_diagnostics_send_hint: Ukuze uthumele umbiko wokuxilonga, kunconywa ukukhetha uhlelo lwe-imeyili.

strings.timer_diagnostics_clear_confirm_body: Yonke imicimbi yokuxilonga isibali sikhathi elondoloziwe izosuswa unomphela.
strings.settings_diagnostics_stopwatch_body: Imicimbi yokuqalisa, ukumisa kancane, ukusetha kabusha, imizuliswano, umlando, ukubuyisela nezaziso zesitophuwashi.
strings.stopwatch_diagnostics_send_hint: Ukuze uthumele umbiko wokuxilonga, kunconywa ukukhetha uhlelo lwe-imeyili.
strings.stopwatch_runtime_log_empty_body: Sebenzisa futhi isitophuwashi, ilogi yemicimbi izovela lapha.
strings.stopwatch_diagnostics_clear_confirm_body: Yonke imicimbi yokuxilonga isitophuwashi elondoloziwe izosuswa unomphela.
strings.settings_backup_button_body: Dala ifayela lekhophi eyisipele elinezilungiselelo zohlelo lokusebenza, ama-alamu, amawashi, idatha yesibali sikhathi nesitophuwashi.
strings.settings_backup_create_body: Ikhophi eyisipele ihlanganisa izilungiselelo, ama-alamu, izinkomba zemisindo yama-alamu eyenziwe ngokwezifiso, amawashi omhlaba, idatha yesibali sikhathi, idatha yesitophuwashi, amanothi namafayela omsindo wamanothi. Amalogi okuxilonga awafakiwe.
strings.settings_backup_header_body: Dala ifayela lekhophi eyisipele le-JSON ongalilondoloza, uzithumele lona noma ulilayishe endaweni yokugcina yamafu. Ukuqinisekiswa kokubuyisela kuyatholakala ngaphambi kokungenisa okuphelele.
strings.settings_backup_restore_body: Khetha ifayela lekhophi eyisipele eladalwa ngaphambilini. Kulesi sigaba, uhlelo lokusebenza luzoqinisekisa ifayela futhi luthathe indawo yedatha yamanje.
strings.settings_backup_restore_confirm_body: Izilungiselelo zamanje zohlelo lokusebenza, ama-alamu, amawashi, idatha yesibali sikhathi nesitophuwashi, amanothi namafayela omsindo wamanothi kuzothathelwa indawo yifayela lekhophi eyisipele elikhethiwe.
strings.settings_backup_restore_restart_body: Idatha yekhophi eyisipele ibuyiselwe ngempumelelo. Qala kabusha uhlelo lokusebenza ukuze zonke izilungiselelo, ama-alamu, amawashi, idatha yesibali sikhathi nesitophuwashi ebuyiselwe iboniswe kahle.
strings.shift_template_one_three_full_day: Amahora angu-24 emsebenzini / izinsuku ezi-3 zokuphumula
strings.settings_diagnostics_shifts_body: Imicimbi yamashejuli amashifu, izinguquko, ikhophi eyisipele, ukubuyisela nezibalo.
strings.shift_diagnostics_send_hint: Ukuze uthumele umbiko wokuxilonga, kunconywa ukukhetha uhlelo lwe-imeyili.
strings.shift_runtime_log_empty_body: Dala noma hlela amashejuli amashifu, ilogi yemicimbi izovela lapha.
strings.shift_diagnostics_clear_confirm_body: Yonke imicimbi yokuxilonga amashifu elondoloziwe izosuswa unomphela.
strings.shifts_screen_header_body: Ungqimba lokugcina lwemojuli yamashifu luxhunyiwe. Isinyathelo esilandelayo: bhala amashejuli bese udala izifanekiso.
strings.shifts_screen_status_body: Isizindalwazi, amamodeli, ikhophi eyisipele/ukubuyisela nokuxilonga kulungisiwe. Isixhumi esibonakalayo sizongezwa isinyathelo ngesinyathelo.
strings.shifts_empty_body: Dala ishejuli yakho yokuqala kusifanekiso. Uhlelo lokusebenza luzobala amashifu ngomjikelezo, hhayi ngezinsuku ezilondoloziwe.
strings.shifts_list_header_body: Amashejuli abalwa kusukela osukwini lokuqala nephethini ephindaphindayo. Izinguquko zezinsuku zizophathwa kamuva ngezinguquko ezikhethekile.
strings.shifts_create_body: Khetha isifanekiso nosuku lokuqala. Ishejuli izobalwa kulo mjikelezo.
strings.calendar_change_shift_body: Dala okuhlukile kosuku olulodwa ngalolu suku
strings.shift_override_day_off_body: Faka ikhefu lomuntu esikhundleni seshifu ebaliwe.
strings.shift_override_custom_body: Faka ishifu yangokwezifiso esikhundleni salolu suku.
strings.shift_override_no_active_schedule: Dala noma wenze ishejuli yamashifu isebenze kuqala.
strings.shifts_edit_body: Shintsha igama leshejuli noma usuku lokuqala. Iphethini nezinguquko ezikhethekile ngeke zishintshe.
strings.shifts_edit_template_locked: Ukuhlela isifanekiso kuzotholakala kamuva kumakhi wephethini.
strings.shifts_custom_pattern_body: Setha ukuhleleka kwezinsuku emjikelezweni ophindaphindayo. Ukuhlela isikhathi kuzongezwa kamuva.
strings.shift_override_range_body: Khetha usuku olulodwa noma ibanga lezinsuku lalokhu okuhlukile.
strings.shift_override_range_end_body: Thepha ukuze ukhethe usuku lokugcina lokuhlukile.
strings.shifts_templates_picker_body: Khetha isifanekiso seshejuli yamashifu esenziwe ngomumo.
strings.shift_override_range_picker_body: Usuku lokuqala lumisiwe. Khetha usuku lokugcina.
strings.shift_override_replace_shift_body: Faka uhlobo oluthile lweshifu esikhundleni sosuku noma ibanga elikhethiwe.
strings.shift_override_edit_shift_body: Faka uhlobo oluthile lweshifu nesikhathi esikhundleni sosuku noma ibanga elikhethiwe.
strings.shifts_template_locked_hint: Ukuhleleka kwezinsuku zokusebenza nezokuphumula kumisiwe kulesi sifanekiso.
strings.shifts_full_day_time_hint: Isikhathi sokuqala nesokuphela siyafana. Lokhu kubalwa njengeshifu yamahora angu-24.
strings.shifts_equal_time_warning_body: Isikhathi sokuqala nesokuphela siyafana, ngakho ishifu izobalwa njengamahora angu-24. Uqinisekile ukuthi isikhathi somsebenzi sikhethwe kahle?
strings.shifts_statistics_body: Izibalo zibalwa kuphela ngale shejuli yamashifu.
strings.shifts_work_break_body: Lungiselela ukuthi isikhathi sekhefu sibalwe yini njengesikhathi somsebenzi.
strings.shifts_statistics_break_body: Setha ukuthi ikhefu lifakiwe yini esikhathini somsebenzi esikhokhelwayo.
strings.shifts_salary_deductions_body: Ukudonswa kwekhefu sekufakiwe esikhathini esisetshenziwe. Sebenzisa le nkambu kuphela ekudonsweni okwenziwa mathupha.
strings.shifts_initial_setup_body: Qedela ukusetha kokuqala. Ngemva kokulondoloza, usuku lokuqala nesakhiwo somjikelezo kuzokhiywa ukuze kuvikelwe izinguquko zekhalenda.
strings.shifts_start_date_locked_body: Usuku lokuqala alukwazi ukushintshwa ngemva kokulondoloza kokuqala. Lokhu kuvikela izinguquko zekhalenda ezilondoloziwe, izinsuku zekhefu, izinsuku zokugula namakhefu omuntu ekubalweni kabusha njengeshejuli entsha.
strings.shifts_cycle_locked_body: Isakhiwo somjikelezo sikhiywa ngemva kokulondoloza kokuqala. Usengakwazi ukuhlela isikhathi sokuqala nesokuphela seshifu.
strings.shift_override_edit_work_time_body: Lungisa isikhathi esisetshenziwe sale shifu yomsebenzi.
strings.shift_override_work_adjustment_body: Engeza isikhathi esengeziwe noma unciphise isikhathi esisetshenziwe salolu suku lomsebenzi.
strings.shift_override_day_off_work_adjustment_b: Setha isikhathi esisetshenziwe salolu suku lokuphumula. Singabalwa njengesikhathi esengeziwe.
strings.shift_override_work_adjustment_hint: Uma isikhathi esengeziwe singavuliwe, isikhathi esingeziwe sibalwa njengesikhathi somsebenzi esijwayelekile.
strings.shifts_salary_overtime_body: Sebenzisa isikhathi esengeziwe esivela ezinguqukweni zamashifu.
strings.shifts_salary_deductions_sheet_body: Engeza imigqa yokudonswa yesikhathi somholo esikhethiwe.
strings.shifts_salary_deduction_delete_body: Lo mugqa wokudonswa uzosuswa ngaphandle kokukwazi ukuwubuyisela.
strings.shifts_salary_bonuses_body: Engeza amabhonasi mathupha noma uwabale njengephesenti lokuthengisa.
strings.shifts_salary_bonus_delete_body: Lo mugqa webhonasi uzosuswa ngaphandle kokukwazi ukuwubuyisela.
strings.shifts_salary_validation_monthly_require: Ngomholo wenyanga, gcwalisa kokubili umholo wenyanga namahora ajwayelekile enyanga.
strings.shifts_salary_validation_bonus_percent_r: Ukuze ulondoloze ibhonasi yephesenti lokuthengisa enenani, faka iphesenti lebhonasi.
strings.shifts_report_body: Imibiko isiza ukuqhathanisa izikhathi eziqediwe, umholo, isikhathi somsebenzi, ukungabikho nezilungiso.
strings.shifts_report_status_completed_body: Lesi sikhathi siphelile. Umbiko ubalwa kudatha yeshejuli nomholo elondoloziwe.
strings.shifts_report_status_preliminary_body: Isikhathi asikapheli. Idatha ibalwa kuze kube namuhla.
strings.shifts_report_status_upcoming_body: Lesi sikhathi asikaqali. Umbiko awukwazi ukwenziwa.
strings.shifts_report_short_summary: Ngesikhathi esingu-{period}, usebenze {hours}, wathola {total}, futhi isikhathi esengeziwe saba {overtime}.
strings.shifts_report_export_body: Londoloza umbiko njenge-PDF, HTML, JSON noma CSV.
strings.shifts_report_daily_rows_entry_body: Vula uhlu olunemininingwane lwezinsuku zalesi sikhathi sombiko.
strings.shifts_report_custom_period_body: Khetha inyanga ethile noma usethe noma yiziphi izinsuku zokuqala nezokugcina.
strings.shifts_report_compare_custom_periods_bod: Khetha izinyanga ezifika kwezi-8, noma engeza amabanga ezinsuku enziwe ngokwezifiso.
strings.shifts_report_compare_empty_body: Khetha izikhathi eziqediwe noma amabanga enziwe ngokwezifiso ukuze ubone idatha yokuqhathanisa.
strings.shifts_report_compare_delta_body: Umugqa ngamunye ubonisa indlela isikhathi esilandelayo esishintshe ngayo uma siqhathaniswa nesangaphambilini.
strings.shifts_report_export_screen_body: Londoloza umbiko okhiqiziwe manje. I-JSON ingcono kudatha ehlelekile ephelele, kanti amafayela e-CSV kulula ukuwavula ezinhlelweni zamaspredishithi.
strings.shifts_report_export_json_body: Umbiko ophelele ohlelekile wokugcina, ukuxilonga, ukuhlaziywa unjiniyela noma ukucubungula okufana nokungenisa kamuva.
strings.shifts_report_export_csv_summary_body: Ithebula elifushane elinomholo, isikhathi somsebenzi, ukungabikho nezinkomba zesikhathi. Lilungele amaspredishithi.
strings.shifts_report_export_csv_daily_body: Ithebula elinemininingwane elinomugqa owodwa ngosuku: uhlobo lweshifu, isikhathi, ubude, isikhathi esengeziwe, ikhefu, ukulungiswa nenothi.
strings.shifts_report_export_pdf_body: Ifayela lombiko elifundekayo lokwabelana, ukuphrinta noma ukuligcina ngaphandle kohlelo lokusebenza.
strings.shifts_report_export_html_body: Umbiko wewebhu ofundekayo onezingxenye nemigqa yansuku zonke. Ulungele ukubukwa esipheqululini nokuphrintwa kamuva.
strings.alarm_shift_linked_body: I-alamu izokhala ngaphambi kweshifu yomsebenzi elandelayo kushejuli esebenzayo.
strings.alarm_shift_linked_no_active_schedule: Ayikho ishejuli yamashifu esebenzayo. Dala noma wenze ishejuli isebenze kuqala.

strings.shift_alarm_choose_kind_body: Le shejuli inezinhlobo eziningi zamashifu omsebenzi. Khetha ukuthi le alamu idalelwe yiphi ishifu.
strings.notes_body: Amanothi ombhalo agcinwa kudivayisi. Lesi sisekelo silungiselelwe amanothi ahlelekile, izikhumbuzi, umsindo nokuguqula izwi libe umbhalo kamuva.
strings.notes_empty_body: Dala inothi lakho lokuqala lombhalo. Amanothi ahlelekile, izikhumbuzi nomsindo kuzongezwa kamuva.
strings.notes_empty_validation: Engeza isihloko noma umbhalo ngaphambi kokulondoloza.
strings.notes_search_empty_body: Zama olunye usesho noma usule ukusesha.
strings.notes_archive_empty_body: Amanothi agcinwe engobolweni yomlando azovela lapha.
strings.settings_diagnostics_notes_body: Imicimbi yokudala, ukuhlela, ukugcina engobolweni, ukususa, ukwenza ikhophi eyisipele nokubuyisela amanothi.
strings.notes_runtime_log_empty_body: Dala, hlela noma ugcine amanothi engobolweni, ilogi yemicimbi izovela lapha.
strings.notes_diagnostics_actions_body: Kopisha, sula noma uthumele umbiko wamanje wokuxilonga amanothi.
strings.notes_diagnostics_clear_confirm_body: Yonke imicimbi yokuxilonga amanothi elondoloziwe izosuswa unomphela.
strings.notes_checklist_editor_hint: Engeza izinto zohlu lokuhlola. Sebenzisa inkinobho ethi + noma isenzo sekhibhodi ukuze wengeze into elandelayo.
strings.notes_unsaved_changes_body: Londoloza izinguquko zakho ngaphambi kokushiya leli nothi?
strings.calendar_add_note_body: Dala umcimbi noma isikhumbuzi salolu suku
strings.notes_advance_reminder_empty_enabled_hin: Engeza okungenani isikhumbuzi esisodwa sangaphambili noma uvale le nketho.
strings.notes_advance_reminder_picker_body: Khetha ukuthi isikhumbuzi kufanele sikhale isikhathi esingakanani ngaphambi kwesikhathi esikhethiwe.
strings.notes_advance_reminder_unavailable_past: Asikho isikhathi esitholakalayo ngaphambi kwalo mcimbi. Qala ngokuhambisa umcimbi esikhathini esizayo.
strings.notes_audio_permission_body: Vumela ukufinyelela kumakrofoni ukuze urekhode amanothi omsindo.
strings.notes_audio_stop_before_save: Misa ukurekhoda ngaphambi kokuphuma noma ukulondoloza.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_architecture_read: Umbhalo wezwi ulungiselelwe njengohlobo lwenothi oluhlukile. Ukuqashelwa kwezwi kuzoxhunywa esinyathelweni esilandelayo.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_ready: Thepha okuthi Qala ukuqashelwa bese ukhuluma. Ungahlela umphumela mathupha ngaphambi kokulondoloza.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_language_locked: Ulimi alukwazi ukushintshwa ngesikhathi ukuqashelwa kusebenza.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_backup_ready: Umbhalo wezwi nemethadatha kufakiwe kukhophi eyisipele nasekubuyiseleni.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_dictation_active_: Ukubizela kuqhubeka kuze kube uthepha okuthi Misa.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_settings_body: Ukuqashelwa ku-inthanethi kuvame ukunemba kakhulu ngoba kungasebenzisa izici zesistimu noma zefu zedivayisi. Imodi engaxhunyiwe isebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi, kodwa ikhwalithi ingaba phansi ngoba ukucubungula kwenzeka ocingweni futhi kuncike kumodeli ekhethiwe.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_model_mis: Imodeli engaxhunyiwe ayikafakwa. Ukulanda kuzongezwa esigabeni semojuli engaxhunyiwe.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_settings_locked: Izilungiselelo azikwazi ukushintshwa ngesikhathi ukubizela kusebenza. Misa ukuqashelwa kuqala.
strings.settings_speech_models_button_body: Landa futhi uphathe amamodeli okuguqula izwi libe umbhalo ukuze uqashelwe ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi.
strings.settings_speech_models_header_body: Landa amamodeli ezwi okuguqula izwi libe umbhalo ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Amamodeli agcinwa kudivayisi futhi ahlolwa nge-SHA-256 ngaphambi kokufakwa.
strings.settings_speech_models_load_failed: Imanifesti yamamodeli ezwi ayikwazanga ukulayishwa. Hlola uxhumano lwakho bese uzama futhi.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_no_models: Awekho amamodeli angaxhunyiwe afakiwe. Vula Amamodeli ezwi angaxhunyiwe Ezilungiselelweni bese ulanda imodeli kuqala.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_quality_h: Ukuqashelwa ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi kusebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Ikhwalithi incike kumodeli ekhethiwe, amandla ocingo nezimo zemakrofoni. Ukuze uthole ukunemba okuphezulu, sebenzisa ukuqashelwa ku-inthanethi.
strings.notes_voice_transcript_offline_quality_s: Ikhwalithi engaxhunyiwe ingaba phansi kuneku-inthanethi ngoba ukucubungula kwenzeka ocingweni.
strings.geo_alarm_empty_body: Dala i-alamu esekelwe endaweni yokungena noma ukuphuma endaweni ekhethiwe.
strings.geo_alarm_stage1_body: Lesi sinyathelo sigcina ama-alamu endawo, ukuxilonga nedatha yekhophi eyisipele. Izimvume zendawo nokulethwa kwangempela kwe-geofence kuzoxhunywa esinyathelweni esilandelayo.
strings.geo_alarm_invalid_latitude: I-latitude kufanele ibe phakathi kuka--90 no-90.
strings.geo_alarm_invalid_longitude: I-longitude kufanele ibe phakathi kuka--180 no-180.
strings.geo_alarm_invalid_data: Hlola idatha ye-alamu yendawo bese uzama futhi.
strings.settings_diagnostics_geo_alarm_body: Imicimbi yokudala, ukuhlela, ukwenza ikhophi eyisipele, ukubuyisela nokulethwa kwe-geofence kwesikhathi esizayo.
strings.geo_alarm_runtime_log_empty_body: Dala noma hlela ama-alamu endawo, ilogi yemicimbi izovela lapha.
strings.geo_alarm_diagnostics_clear_confirm_body: Yonke imicimbi yokuxilonga i-alamu yendawo elondoloziwe izosuswa unomphela.
strings.geo_alarm_stage2_body: Izimvume zendawo nokubhaliswa kwe-geofence kuxhunyiwe. Lapho indawo elondoloziwe iqala, uhlelo lokusebenza lubhala ukuxilonga futhi lubonise isaziso. Ukukhala okugcwele kuzoxhunywa esinyathelweni esilandelayo.
strings.geo_alarm_runtime_package2_body: Ukubhaliswa kwe-geofence, ukubuyisela ngemva kokuqalisa, isamukeli sezinguquko, ukuxilonga nokulethwa kwezaziso kuvuliwe.
strings.geo_alarm_reliability_body: Ama-alamu asekelwe endaweni adinga ukufinyelela indawo, indawo yangemuva nezaziso. I-Android isengabambezela imicimbi ye-geofence ukuze yonge ibhethri.
strings.geo_alarm_permission_precise_missing: Indawo elinganiselwe kuphela noma akukho kufinyelela
strings.geo_alarm_permission_background_missing: Vumela ngaso sonke isikhathi ezilungiselelweni zohlelo lokusebenza
strings.geo_alarm_vendor_hint_body: Ku-Xiaomi, Redmi, POCO, MIUI noma HyperOS, vumela futhi ukuziqalela bese ususa imikhawulo yebhethri ye-ShiftAlarm. Uma kungenjalo imicimbi ye-geofence ingafika sekwephuzile.
strings.geo_alarm_stage21_body: Lesi sinyathelo sengeza izinqamuleli zezimvume, amathiphu okwethembeka nokuxilonga okunemininingwane. Ukukhala okugcwele kuzoxhunywa ngemva kokuqinisekiswa kokusebenza kwe-geofence.
strings.geo_alarm_ringing_channel_description: Umsindo, ukudlidliza nezaziso zesikrini esigcwele ze-alamu yendawo
strings.geo_alarm_cooldown_hint_body: Ukuqalisa okuphindaphindiwe koshintsho olufanayo lwe-alamu yendawo kungase kunganakwa imizuzu embalwa ukuze kugwenywe ukukhala okuphindaphindiwe eduze komngcele wendawo.
strings.geo_alarm_duplicate_protection_body: Ukuvikelwa ekuphindaphindeni: umcimbi ofanayo wokungena noma ukuphuma ngeke uphinde ukhale imizuzu emi-3. Umcimbi ophambene usengakhala.
strings.geo_alarm_map_location_unavailable: Indawo yamanje ayitholakali. Zama futhi ngaphandle noma uhlole izilungiselelo zendawo.
strings.geo_alarm_map_provider_later: I-Google Maps, Yandex Maps, izendlalelo zesathelayithi nenhlanganisela zigcinelwe amaphakheji azayo. Iphakheji yamanje isebenzisa i-OpenStreetMap.
strings.geo_alarm_radius_step_hint: Irediyasi ishintsha ngezinyathelo ezingu-200 m. Okuphezulu: 5000 m.
strings.geo_alarm_radius_reliability_warning: Irediyasi engaphansi kuka-800 m ingase iqale sekwephuzile ngenxa yokonga ibhethri nokunemba kwendawo.
strings.geo_alarm_radius_android_hint: Ukuze i-alamu yendawo ithembeke, kunconywa u-800–1000 m.
strings.geo_alarm_map_search_not_found: Ikheli alitholakalanga. Zama umbuzo ophelele: idolobha, umgwaqo nenombolo yendlu.
strings.geo_alarm_map_reverse_geocode_online_fir: Ukusesha ikheli kuqala kusebenzisa idatha eku-inthanethi, bese kusebenzisa i-geocoder yedivayisi uma inethiwekhi ingatholakali.
strings.geo_alarm_trigger_hint: I-alamu yendawo izovuleka lapho kutholwa isimo sendawo esikhethiwe.
strings.geo_alarm_location_hint_read_only: Iphuzu likhethwa kumephu. Lapha ungahlela kuphela ikheli eliboniswayo.
strings.geo_alarm_schedule_type_hint: Le alamu isebenzisa indawo ekhethiwe kumephu esikhundleni sesikhathi sewashi.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_disabled_hint: Vula i-alamu yendawo esikrinini semephu ukuze ubhalise i-geofence yayo.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_ready_hint: Izimvume zilungisiwe. Ukubhaliswa kwe-alamu yendawo kufanele kusebenze.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_location_hint: Vumela imvume yendawo ukuze ubhalise indawo ekhethiwe.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_background_hint: Vumela ukufinyelela indawo ngaso sonke isikhathi ukuze iqale ngokuthembekile lapho uhlelo lokusebenza luvaliwe.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_notification_hint: Vumela izaziso ukuze i-alamu yendawo ikwazi ukubonisa izaziso zokukhala.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_google_play_hint: Amasevisi e-Google Play ayadingeka ukuze i-Android geofencing isebenze kule divayisi.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_setup_hint: Londoloza i-alamu yendawo, uhlelo lokusebenza luzobhalisa i-geofence.
strings.geo_alarm_readiness_error_hint: Hlola izimvume nokuxilonga uma ukubhalisa kwehluleka.
strings.alarm_duration_hint: I-alamu izoma ngokuzenzakalelayo ngemva kobude obukhethiwe.
strings.geo_alarm_schedule_mode_always_hint: I-alamu yendawo isebenza nsuku zonke ngesikhathi ivuliwe.
strings.geo_alarm_schedule_mode_one_time_hint: Ngemva kokuqalisa okuphumelelayo kokuqala, i-alamu yendawo izovalwa.
strings.geo_alarm_schedule_mode_repeat_days_hint: I-alamu yendawo ikhala kuphela ngezinsuku zesonto ezikhethiwe.
strings.geo_alarm_schedule_mode_shift_linked_hin: I-alamu yendawo ikhala kuphela ngamashifu omsebenzi akhethiwe.
strings.geo_alarm_repeat_days_required: Khetha okungenani usuku olulodwa lwale alamu yendawo.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_schedule_empty: Awekho amashejuli amashifu okwamanje. Dala ishejuli kuqala.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_schedule_body: Le alamu yendawo isebenzisa kuphela ishejuli yamashifu esebenzayo.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_schedule_required: Yenza ishejuli yamashifu isebenze ngaphambi kokulondoloza i-alamu yendawo exhunyiwe kushifu.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_timing_body: Khetha ukuthi le alamu yendawo isebenze ngosuku lweshifu, ngosuku olwandulela lona noma ngosuku olulandela lona.
strings.geo_alarm_bookmark_remove_alarm_confirm_: Kuzosuswa kuphela okufakiwe ezindaweni ezilondoloziwe. I-alamu yendawo ngokwayo izosala.
strings.geo_alarm_bookmark_remove_point_confirm_: Kuzosuswa kuphela leli phuzu elilondoloziwe. Ama-alamu endawo ngeke ashintshwe.
strings.geo_alarm_map_location_permission_body: Vumela imvume yendawo ukuze imephu ibonise indawo yakho yamanje.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_schedule_no_active: Ayikho ishejuli yamashifu esebenzayo. Yenza ishejuli yamashifu isebenze kuqala.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_schedule_active_body: Le alamu yendawo izoxhunywa kushejuli yamashifu esebenzayo.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_schedule_inactive_body: Le alamu yendawo ixhunywe kushejuli yamashifu engasebenzi manje.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_before_window_body: I-alamu yendawo isebenza kuphela ngaphakathi kwalesi sikhathi ngaphambi kokuqala kweshifu.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_after_until_crossing_val: Isebenza ngemva kweshifu kuze kube ukuwela kokuqala kwe-geofence
strings.geo_alarm_shift_after_until_crossing_bod: Uma i-geofence ingawelwanga, ukuqaliswa okulindile ngemva kweshifu kusethwa kabusha lapho ishifu elandelayo iqala noma ekupheleni kosuku.
strings.geo_alarm_shift_after_until_crossing_she: Isebenza ngemva kweshifu kuze kube ukuwela kokuqala kwe-geofence
strings.geo_alarm_map_offline_cache_body: Imephu izobonisa izindawo ezilondoloziwe uma zavulwa ngaphambilini. Izindawo ezingekho zizolayishwa futhi lapho i-inthanethi itholakala.
strings.widget_config_4x3_body: Khetha izinkinobho ezimbili zolwazi. Namuhla newashi kuhlala kuboniswa phezulu.
strings.widget_config_calendar_4x4_v2_body: Khetha izinkinobho ezimbili ezimfishane. Ikhalenda neshejuli yakusasa kuhlala kuboniswa.
strings.alarm_repeat_after_ignored_body: Uma ungayivali noma ungayihlehlisi, i-alamu izophinde ikhale.
strings.settings_speech_models_download_continue: Ukulandwa kwamamodeli kuyaqhubeka ngisho noma uphuma kulesi sikrini.
strings.settings_permissions_alarm_geo_summary_b: Setha ukwethembeka kwama-alamu okuvuka, ukufinyelela indawo kwama-alamu endawo nezilungiselelo zebhethri endaweni eyodwa.
strings.settings_permissions_geo_first_launch_bo: Ama-alamu endawo adinga ukufinyelela indawo, indawo enembile nendawo yangemuva ukuze aqale lapho uhlelo lokusebenza luvaliwe. Ungazivumela ezilungiselelweni zohlelo lokusebenza.
strings.settings_permissions_unrestricted_body: Ukuze ama-alamu nama-alamu endawo asebenze ngokuthembekile, susa imikhawulo yebhethri ye-ShiftAlarm. Ku-Xiaomi/Redmi nakwamanye amadivayisi afanayo, vumela futhi ukuziqalela/umsebenzi wangemuva uma kutholakala.
strings.settings_backup_save_body: Dala ifayela lekhophi eyisipele bese ukhetha ukuthi lilondolozwe kuphi kule divayisi.
strings.settings_backup_share_body: Dala ifayela lekhophi eyisipele bese uvula isikrini sesistimu sokwabelana ukuze ulithumele nge-imeyili, umlayezo noma indawo yokugcina yamafu.
strings.settings_backup_export_save_success_body: Ifayela lekhophi eyisipele lilondolozwe endaweni ekhethiwe.
strings.settings_backup_export_share_success_bod: Khetha ukuthi ifayela lekhophi eyisipele lithunyelwe noma lilayishwe kuphi.
strings.settings_backup_export_share_error_body: Ifayela lekhophi eyisipele alikwazanga ukudalwa noma ukwabelwana ngalo.
strings.shifts_salary_deduction_constant_carry_h: Ukudonswa okuhlala njalo kudluliselwa enyangeni elandelayo ngokuzenzakalelayo.
strings.settings_legal_button_body: Vula imigomo, inqubomgomo yobumfihlo, isitatimende sokuzihlangula nomhlahlandlela womsebenzisi.
strings.legal_documents_intro_body: Amadokhumenti atholakala ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Uma i-inthanethi itholakala, i-ShiftAlarm ingalanda izinguqulo zamanje futhi isebenzise amakhophi afakiwe uma kudingeka.
strings.legal_privacy_body: Indlela idatha yasendaweni yohlelo lokusebenza, ukuxilonga nokulandwa okuphathwa ngayo.
strings.legal_disclaimer_body: Imikhawulo ebalulekile yokwethembeka kwama-alamu, izaziso nama-geofence.
strings.legal_help_body: Umhlahlandlela ongaxhunyiwe wemisebenzi eyinhloko yohlelo lokusebenza.
strings.legal_document_unavailable_body: Idokhumenti ayikwazanga ukuvulwa. Hlola uxhumano noma uzame futhi kamuva.
strings.onboarding_step_welcome_body: I-ShiftAlarm ihlanganisa amashejuli amashifu, ama-alamu, ama-alamu endawo, amanothi, amawijethi namathuluzi ekhophi eyisipele. Isikrini esikhulu sesivele sitholakala ngemuva kwaleli windi lokusetha.
strings.onboarding_step_documents_body: Sicela uvule amadokhumenti ohlelo lokusebenza bese wamukela izinguqulo ezidingekayo. Achaza imigomo yokusebenzisa, ubumfihlo nemikhawulo yokwethembeka kwama-alamu, izaziso nama-alamu endawo.
strings.onboarding_step_permissions_body: Izimvume azidingeki ukuze uphequlule uhlelo lokusebenza, kodwa ama-alamu, izikhumbuzi nama-alamu endawo ancike ezazisweni, kuma-alamu anembile, endaweni nasezilungiselelweni zebhethri.
strings.onboarding_permissions_finish_hint: Ungaqeda manje bese ubuyela ezimvumeni kamuva usebenzisa Izilungiselelo.
strings.settings_help_training_button_body: Vula umhlahlandlela womsebenzisi ongaxhunyiwe ewindini elihlukile lesiphequluli.
strings.help_training_offer_body: Vula umhlahlandlela womsebenzisi ukuze ufunde ukuthi umsebenzi ngamunye oyinhloko wenzani, utholakala kuphi, yini okufanele uyithinte nokuthi yini ongayihlola uma okuthile kungasebenzi ngendlela elindelekile.
strings.help_training_offer_hint: Umhlahlandlela uvuleka njengekhasi lendawo elihlukile, ngakho ungashintsha phakathi komhlahlandlela nohlelo lokusebenza ngesikhathi ulandela izinyathelo.
strings.help_training_offer_open_failed: Umhlahlandlela awukwazanga ukuvulwa. Zama futhi usebenzisa Izilungiselelo.
strings.settings_theme_language_group_body: Itimu, ulimi lohlelo lokusebenza namamodeli ezwi angaxhunyiwe kuqoqwe lapha.
strings.settings_documents_instruction_group_bod: Amadokhumenti, usizo, ukuqeqeshwa nomhlahlandlela womsebenzisi kuqoqwe lapha.
strings.notes_advance_reminder_delete_confirm_bo: Isikhumbuzi sangaphambili esingu-{time} ngaphambi kwesikhathi esikhethiwe sizosuswa.
strings.alarm_repeat_days_required_error: Khetha okungenani usuku olulodwa lwe-alamu ephindaphindayo.
strings.settings_speech_models_delete_confirm_bo: Imodeli ethi “{model}” namafayela ayo endawo kuzosuswa. Ungayilanda futhi imodeli kamuva.
strings.alarm_runtime_log_empty_body: Qalisa futhi izimo ze-alamu, imicimbi yelogi izovela lapha.
strings.alarm_shift_linked_inactive_schedule_err: Yenza le shejuli yamashifu isebenze ngaphambi kokulondoloza i-alamu yeshifu.
strings.settings_backup_validation_invalid_json: Ifayela elikhethiwe aliyona ikhophi eyisipele ye-JSON evumelekile.
strings.settings_backup_validation_wrong_app: Ifayela elikhethiwe aliyona ikhophi eyisipele ye-ShiftAlarm.
strings.settings_backup_validation_timer_incompl: Ibhulokhi yesibali sikhathi kukhophi eyisipele ayiphelele: {fields}.
strings.settings_backup_validation_shift_salary_: Ibhulokhi yezilungiselelo zomholo wamashifu kukhophi eyisipele ayiphelele.
strings.settings_backup_validation_note_audio_in: Ibhulokhi yamafayela omsindo wamanothi kukhophi eyisipele ayiphelele.
strings.settings_backup_validation_geo_alarms_in: Ibhulokhi yama-alamu endawo kukhophi eyisipele ayiphelele.
strings.settings_backup_validation_geo_bookmarks: Ibhulokhi yezindawo ezilondoloziwe zama-alamu endawo kukhophi eyisipele ayiphelele.

strings.notes_transcript_error_network_timeout: Isikhathi sokulinda inethiwekhi sokuqashelwa kwezwi siphelile.
